correctness.rationale: Original vertices equal ±h±w_j, making an orthogonal segment plus an invertible cross-polytope factor. The w_j Gram matrix is I+J/2 with inverse I−J/(q+2), so each sign facet normal has squared norm q−S^2/(q+2), plus two segment end facets. Maximizing normal norm over sign sums gives Q_q and inradius Q_q^-1/2. At tight balanced facets the center cross-coordinates must be zero for odd q or constant for even q; all other inequalities give |t|≤1−sqrt(2)/sqrt(Q_q), |s|≤(1−sqrt(1−4/[q(q+2)]))/2. Monotonic scalar bound f(|S|) implies first new tangencies at |S|=2. Independent sign-shell arithmetic verified q=3..12 and positive rectangle corner feasibility; provided checker code also inspected.
